stage1.impression: A legible cutaway of a house-shaped object with a glossy red horn and a black driver, but the beige section and the warm-grey backdrop are each one flat value, so most of the frame reads as a CAD fill rather than a lit photograph. A zipper of jagged sparkles along the horn's lower crease, a grainy grey band under the horn, a near-black driver block, a dull brick-red chimney that does not match the gloss red, and a crop that stops in the rooms with no ground keep it a draft.

blocking_9: The birch section reads as a lit plane: at least 15 levels of falloff from the ridge to the top panel on the section left of the bay.
The interior recedes: the left room wall [600,740,840,890] at least 40 levels under the section mid-tone [250,560,520,630] (now 215.3 vs 209.0).
No faceting in the horn: edge (x) <= 6 in [1060,553,1100,566] (now 15.0).
Clean section fills: the insert's cut face p5-p95 range <= 3.5 in [800,590,860,620] (now 6.5).
The accent reads as the accent: the fin's front face within dE2000 6 of #C62828 (now 14.91), the horn's diffuse red within dE2000 5 (now 7.19).
A finished backdrop: a soft pool of at least 10 levels across the top band (now 4.0), neutral.
The tweeter's dome profile separates from the throat red by at least 25 luminance levels (now 62.2 vs 50.4).

changes.problem: The interior is brighter than the cut face in front of it, so depth reads inverted and the eye drops into the empty left room instead of the tweeter.

evidence.measured: Left room back wall lum_median 215.3 against the birch section [250,560,520,630] at 209.0; the inside lamp at 5 deg shines under the top panel straight onto the back wall.

changes.expected: The visible room walls fall to about 120-150, at least 45 levels under the section; the connector bay and channel stay lit from above-front.

changes.problem: The rim highlight on the crease along the horn's lower wall breaks into a row of saw-tooth sparkles, a tessellation artefact on the hero part.

evidence.measured: edge (x) 15.0 against 0.4 on smooth red; diagonal highlight dashes about 4.5 mm apart along the crease; waveguide-insert pixels.

change.setting: asset: waveguide-insert mesh, horn surface along its lower crease
change.to: smooth vertex normals on the round, split only at true sharp edges; profile unchanged

changes.expected: One continuous crease highlight; edge in the test box <= 6.

changes.problem: The birch cut face is one value from ridge to top panel and from eave to insert, so it reads as a flat fill rather than a lit section.

evidence.measured: birch section falloff 0.7; red channel at 240-242, above PBR Neutral's knee.

changes.expected: About 10-18 levels brighter near the ridge than at the top panel; section mid-tone about 195-203.

changes.problem: Sky ambient sets the backdrop and fills every plane evenly, so the sweep is a flat mid-grey card and the shaping lamps cannot model the product.

evidence.measured: top band range 4.0; left strip median 158.9, only about 50 levels under the 209 section.

changes.expected: The backdrop drops to about 120-135; the fin's clear-coat veil falls by about a third.

changes.problem: Moved to 0.7 m at its current 0.9 m size, the key would smear every specular it makes and soften the falloff c3 is for.

evidence.measured: magnets-insert lum_p95 239.0; a 0.9 m panel at 0.7 m has about 3.5x the solid angle of today's key.

changes.expected: The key keeps today's angular size at 0.7 m; magnets' p95 stays at 215 or above.

changes.problem: The insert's grey cut face carries a vertical streak grain that reads as noise next to the clean birch section.

evidence.measured: p5-p95 range 6.5 against 3.0 on the birch; vertical streaks of about 21 px period.

change.from: grey section with a streaked grain
change.to: smooth matte section shader at the same colour and value, no bump or grain

changes.expected: The insert's cut face as clean as the birch: range <= 3.5.

changes.problem: The fin's front face reads dusty brick instead of the accent red because no lamp reaches it and the clear coat mirrors the grey sweep.

evidence.measured: fin front face rgb 151,96,88, dE2000 14.91 vs #C62828; throat right of the dome lum 50.4 against the dome 62.2.

changes.expected: The fin face about rgb 185,78,75, dE2000 about 8; the throat lifts (r_median at least 175); no new highlights.

changes.problem: The sweep has no light of its own, so even darkened it stays an even field with nothing to seat the roof in.

evidence.measured: top band range 4.0; backdrop pixel range 2.7 in [20,300,150,400].

changes.expected: A soft pool on the sweep behind the roof; the top band's range 8-12; nothing on the product changes.

out_of_scope.request: Separate the insert's cut face from the birch cut face in value (207.2 vs 209.0).
out_of_scope.why: Section colours are fixed and only their reproduction may change.

out_of_scope.request: Finish the routed connector bay and cable channel walls in raw birch instead of the red lacquer.
out_of_scope.why: The product's materials are fixed; the black lead separates from the dark red walls only by its sheen.

out_of_scope.request: Re-route the tweeter cable after the grommet so it drops straight into the box.
out_of_scope.why: The cable path is part of the product arrangement (fixed).
